description: Post-earthquake concrete crack dataset (PECCD) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Ali Mahmoud Mayya, Nizar Faisal Alkayem (Tishreen University). This dataset involves a post-earthquake multi-feature annotated concrete defect image dataset. The dataset called “post-earthquake concrete crack dataset (PECCD)” is collected from damaged buildings in the Syrian Coast region after the Turkey-Syria earthquake 2023. The considered defect types are: deep crack, simple crack, multi-branched crack, spalling, scaling, and holes. Coverage: national (SY); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
